calculation.description: Negative five-session asset return, strengthened when lagged five-session VIX change is positive and downscaled otherwise. VIX and prices are observed only through the completed decision-day bar; higher values indicate stronger reversal preference.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in every calendar year; annual IC ranged from 0.0123 in 2025 to 0.1185 in 2022. Daily predictive strength is materially shorter-horizon than the 5d/10d variants. Conservative interpretation is required because the cross-section is 15 assets and effective coverage is 49.98%.
